definitions.gloss: hot, dry and fluffy (of potatoes, chestnuts, pumpkin)
definitions.explanation: Describes starchy food that is freshly cooked, steaming, and crumbly-soft rather than wet or sticky.
Happy and satisfied, typically about money or a good result.

examples.japanese: ホクホク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{焼|や}き{芋|いも}→焼き芋：15650_yakiimo⟧。
examples.english: A steaming, fluffy baked sweet potato.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ホクホク⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: These potatoes are nice and fluffy.

examples.japanese: {蒸|む}したて⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦かぼちゃ→かぼちゃ：10306_kabocha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ホクホクで、⟦{砂糖|さとう}→砂糖：00884_satou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れなくて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{甘|あま}い→甘い：00617_amai⟧。
examples.english: Freshly steamed pumpkin is fluffy and sweet even without sugar.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボーナス→ボーナス：05878_boonasu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}て→出る：00513_deru⟧ホクホクだ。
examples.english: I got my bonus and I'm delighted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{店主|てんしゅ}→店主：12451_tenshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{売|う}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びて→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧ホクホク{顔|がお}だ。
examples.english: The shop owner is all smiles because sales are up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{宝|たから}くじ→宝くじ：18549_takarakuji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ホクホクし⟦ながら→ながら：10530_nagara⟧⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: My father came home beaming because he had won the lottery.

notes:
A mimetic word, also written ほくほく. Sense 1 contrasts with ねっとり (sticky, moist): ホクホク⟦{系|けい}→〜系：28466_kei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧ are floury potatoes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホクホク⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦じゃがいも→じゃがいも：05184_jagaimo⟧: fluffy potatoes
- ホクホク⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be fluffy; to be delighted
- ホクホク{顔|がお}: a beaming, satisfied face

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ほっこり→ほっこり：06276_hokkori⟧: warm and soft; heartwarming
- ほくそ{笑|え}む: to chuckle to oneself (with satisfaction)
